title: 分级 · 小学｜观察与小故事 · 60 句
description: 公园观察、简单实验、手工游戏、故事读图与校外见闻；衔接基础过去时和简短原因表达。

items.zh: 树叶浮在水面上。
items.en: A leaf is floating on the water.
answers: A leaf is floating on the water.
items.notes: is floating：正在漂浮；leaf 的复数为 leaves。

items.zh: 两只松鼠绕着树追逐。
items.en: Two squirrels are chasing each other around a tree.
answers: Two squirrels are chasing each other around a tree.

items.zh: 脚下的草还湿着。
items.en: The grass under our feet is still wet.
answers: The grass under our feet is still wet.

items.zh: 那根树枝上没有叶子。
items.en: There are no leaves on that branch.
answers: There are no leaves on that branch.
items.notes: branch：树枝；there are 表示某处有。

items.zh: 一阵风吹走了我的帽子。
items.en: A gust of wind blew my hat away.
answers: A gust of wind blew my hat away.
items.notes: blow away：吹走；blew 为过去式。

items.zh: 蜗牛把头缩进了壳里。
items.en: The snail pulled its head into its shell.
answers: The snail pulled its head into its shell.
items.notes: pull ... into ...：缩进；its 表示它的。

items.zh: 湖边的鸟比操场上的多。
items.en: There are more birds by the lake than on the playground.
answers: There are more birds by the lake than on the playground.

items.zh: 小路尽头有一张长椅。
items.en: A bench stands at the end of the path.
answers: A bench stands at the end of the path.

items.zh: 我们在倒下的树干上休息。
items.en: We are resting on a fallen tree.
answers: We are resting on a fallen tree.

items.zh: 影子跟着我们一起移动。
items.en: Our shadows move with us.
answers: Our shadows move with us.

items.zh: 这块石头沉下去了，木片没有。
items.en: The stone sank, but the wood did not.
answers: The stone sank, but the wood did not.
The stone sank, but the wood didn't.
items.notes: sank 是 sink 的过去式；did not 省略相同动作。

items.zh: 往杯里加水，直到这条线。
items.en: Fill the cup with water up to this line.
answers: Fill the cup with water up to this line.

items.zh: 冰块正在慢慢变小。
items.en: The ice cube is getting smaller.
answers: The ice cube is getting smaller.

items.zh: 这块磁铁吸不住木头。
items.en: This magnet does not attract wood.
answers: This magnet does not attract wood.
This magnet doesn't attract wood.

items.zh: 你能让纸船一直浮着吗？
items.en: Can you keep the paper boat afloat?
answers: Can you keep the paper boat afloat?

items.zh: 我用绳子比较两张桌子的长度。
items.en: I use string to compare the lengths of two tables.
answers: I use string to compare the lengths of two tables.

items.zh: 两个空杯子一样重。
items.en: The two empty cups weigh the same.
answers: The two empty cups weigh the same.

items.zh: 水变色了，但闻起来没变。
items.en: The water changed colour but smelled the same.
answers: The water changed colour but smelled the same.
items.notes: change colour：变色；smell 后可接状态描述。

items.zh: 先猜一猜，再试一试。
items.en: Make a guess before you test it.
answers: Make a guess before you test it.
items.notes: make a guess：猜一猜；before 表示顺序。

items.zh: 我在纸上画出了看到的变化。
items.en: I drew the changes I saw on paper.
answers: I drew the changes I saw on paper.
items.notes: drew 是 draw 的过去式；I saw 修饰 changes。

items.zh: 沿着虚线把纸折起来。
items.en: Fold the paper along the dotted line.
answers: Fold the paper along the dotted line.

items.zh: 两个圆圈只要部分重叠。
items.en: The two circles should overlap a little.
answers: The two circles should overlap a little.

items.zh: 胶水还没干，先别碰。
items.en: Do not touch it yet; the glue is still wet.
answers: Do not touch it yet; the glue is still wet.
Don't touch it yet; the glue is still wet.

items.zh: 我们用纸盒做了一座城堡。
items.en: We built a castle out of cardboard boxes.
answers: We built a castle out of cardboard boxes.

items.zh: 这个纸风车要迎着风。
items.en: The paper windmill needs to face the wind.
answers: The paper windmill needs to face the wind.

items.zh: 骰子落到椅子下面了。
items.en: The dice landed under the chair.
answers: The dice landed under the chair.

items.zh: 你要向后退两格。
items.en: You need to move back two spaces.
answers: You need to move back two spaces.

items.zh: 我们还没决定谁先开始。
items.en: We have not decided who goes first.
answers: We have not decided who goes first.
We haven't decided who goes first.

items.zh: 拼图少了最角上的一块。
items.en: The jigsaw is missing a corner piece.
answers: The jigsaw is missing a corner piece.

items.zh: 这个游戏没有赢家或输家。
items.en: This game has no winners or losers.
answers: This game has no winners or losers.
items.notes: winner 与 loser：赢家与输家。

items.zh: 封面上的女孩在找什么？
items.en: What is the girl on the cover looking for?
answers: What is the girl on the cover looking for?
items.notes: look for：寻找；on the cover：封面上的。

items.zh: 故事一开始，村里所有人都睡着了。
items.en: At the start of the story, everyone in the village was asleep.
answers: At the start of the story, everyone in the village was asleep.

items.zh: 小熊听见门外有人哭。
items.en: The little bear heard someone crying outside the door.
answers: The little bear heard someone crying outside the door.
items.notes: hear someone doing：听见某人正在做。

items.zh: 狐狸假装没看见篮子。
items.en: The fox pretended not to see the basket.
answers: The fox pretended not to see the basket.

items.zh: 我觉得下一页会出现一条龙。
items.en: I think a dragon will appear on the next page.
answers: I think a dragon will appear on the next page.
items.notes: I think 后接猜测；will appear：将出现。

items.zh: 最后，小船把他们带回了家。
items.en: In the end, the little boat took them home.
answers: In the end, the little boat took them home.
items.notes: in the end：最后；take someone home：送某人回家。

items.zh: 哪一幅图发生在最前面？
items.en: Which picture shows what happened first?
answers: Which picture shows what happened first?
items.notes: which 询问选择；what happened first：最先发生的事。

items.zh: 这一页没有文字，你能讲讲图中的故事吗？
items.en: There are no words on this page. Can you tell the story in the picture?
answers: There are no words on this page. Can you tell the story in the picture?
items.notes: there are no：没有；tell a story：讲故事。

items.zh: 我喜欢结尾，因为他们成了朋友。
items.en: I like the ending because they become friends.
answers: I like the ending because they become friends.

items.zh: 换成你，你会打开那扇门吗？
items.en: Would you open that door?
answers: Would you open that door?
items.notes: would 用于想象情境中的选择。

items.zh: 车窗上有一层雾。
items.en: The bus window is covered in mist.
answers: The bus window is covered in mist.

items.zh: 我们坐过了要下车的那一站。
items.en: We missed our stop.
answers: We missed our stop.
items.notes: miss a stop：错过该下车的站。

items.zh: 售票处前面排着长队。
items.en: There is a long queue at the ticket office.
answers: There is a long queue at the ticket office.

items.zh: 博物馆里的这副骨架比我还高。
items.en: This skeleton in the museum is taller than me.
answers: This skeleton in the museum is taller than me.

items.zh: 请站在黄线后面等。
items.en: Please wait behind the yellow line.
answers: Please wait behind the yellow line.
items.notes: behind：在后面，区别于 on（在线上）。

items.zh: 我认出了照片里的那座桥。
items.en: I recognised the bridge in the photograph.
answers: I recognised the bridge in the photograph.
items.notes: recognise：认出；in the photograph：照片里的。

items.zh: 面包店飘出了好闻的气味。
items.en: A lovely smell came from the bakery.
answers: A lovely smell came from the bakery.

items.zh: 这里的路牌指向两个方向。
items.en: The signs here point in two directions.
answers: The signs here point in two directions.

items.zh: 我可以摸这块岩石吗？
items.en: Am I allowed to touch this rock?
answers: Am I allowed to touch this rock?
items.notes: be allowed to：被允许做某事。

items.zh: 我们买了一张明信片寄给老师。
items.en: We bought a postcard to send to our teacher.
answers: We bought a postcard to send to our teacher.
items.notes: to send 表示购买目的；postcard：明信片。

items.zh: 豆苗今天长出了第二片叶子。
items.en: The bean plant grew its second leaf today.
answers: The bean plant grew its second leaf today.
items.notes: second：第二；grew 是 grow 的过去式。

items.zh: 我数到六只蚂蚁进了洞。
items.en: I counted six ants going into the hole.
answers: I counted six ants going into the hole.
items.notes: count someone doing：数出正在做某事的对象。

items.zh: 雨停后，地上留下许多水坑。
items.en: The rain left many puddles on the ground.
answers: The rain left many puddles on the ground.

items.zh: 这张照片拍的是同一棵树的冬天。
items.en: This photograph shows the same tree in winter.
answers: This photograph shows the same tree in winter.

items.zh: 我按大小把贝壳排好了。
items.en: I arranged the shells by size.
answers: I arranged the shells by size.

items.zh: 没有人碰它，气球却破了。
items.en: Nobody touched it, but the balloon burst.
answers: Nobody touched it, but the balloon burst.

items.zh: 我把今天的日期写在画旁边。
items.en: I wrote today's date beside the drawing.
answers: I wrote today's date beside the drawing.
items.notes: beside：在旁边；wrote 是 write 的过去式。

items.zh: 我们听见了青蛙，却没看见它。
items.en: We heard a frog without seeing it.
answers: We heard a frog without seeing it.

items.zh: 同一条路，下雨时看起来很不一样。
items.en: The same path looks very different in the rain.
answers: The same path looks very different in the rain.

items.zh: 明天我想看看它有没有变化。
items.en: Tomorrow I want to see whether it has changed.
answers: Tomorrow I want to see whether it has changed.
items.notes: whether：是否；has changed 表示已发生的变化。
